# Selenium Reporting Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > QA > Selenium

## Overview

Implements test reporting for Selenium with rich HTML reports, screenshots, logs, and trend analysis for test result visibility

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [selenium-reporting-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
selenium-reporting-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@selenium-reporting-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Generate HTML reports with ExtentReports or Allure
- Capture screenshots on test failure
- Attach browser logs to test reports
- Implement trend analysis across test runs

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Allure**: Rich test reporting framework
- **ExtentReports**: HTML report generation for Selenium
- **Test Trends**: Historical test result analysis
